newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Feb 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Feb 5.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Some 400 French investigating magistrates sign international call against global financial bribery and corruption, and for improved international co-operation.

-- A Paribas report on Credit Foncier, submitted to the government in December, estimates a 1996 profit of around 1.2 billion francs; says to have chance of remaining viable Foncier would need recapitalisation of six billion francs and would need some form of debt-issuing guarantor.
-- Paris commercial court to rule on February 28 on various possible bailout plans for bank Pallas Stern or declare bankruptcy.

-- Paris court rules that former domestic airline Air Inter has right to strike without notice as it no longer is a public service, but will lose this right when merger with Air France is effective, on April 1, 1997. Paper adds Air Inter may use this to protest against conditions of merger.
